reuse.why: Reuses budget writes, spreadsheet reads, batching and undo wrappers, but setBulkNMonthAvg duplicates setNMonthAvg and copyPreviousMonth bypasses the new shared eligibility helpers.

duplication.why: Consolidates the three bulk average actions, but retains duplicated category eligibility rules and average calculation, sign conversion and budget writing.

placement.why: Budget policy and calculations remain in budget/actions.ts, with handler registration and undo integration in budget/app.ts.

scope.why: Changes are confined to the requested month-wide actions, their registration and relevant tests.

maintainability.why: The shared bulk helpers improve ownership, but separate eligibility implementations and duplicated average orchestration leave multiple places to update.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts: copyPreviousMonth independently applies eligibility instead of sharing getBulkBudgetCategories/shouldBudgetCategory, while setBulkNMonthAvg reproduces setNMonthAvg orchestration.

disguised_duplication.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts: eligibility appears as SQL predicates plus filtering in getBulkBudgetCategories and as imperative guards in copyPreviousMonth; setBulkNMonthAvg reshapes setNMonthAvg's calculation/sign/write sequence into a loop.

abstraction_drift.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts: includeHiddenCategories extends the shared bulk selector, but copyPreviousMonth maintains parallel eligibility rules and setBulkNMonthAvg bypasses the existing setNMonthAvg action.
